idea-plugin.name: Kotlin Coroutine Visualizer
idea-plugin.description:
Run any Kotlin/JVM application with live coroutine visualization, directly from IntelliJ IDEA.
  • One-click Run with Coroutine Visualizer — attaches a bundled Java agent to your run configuration with zero code changes.
  • The agent captures coroutine activity via kotlinx-coroutines DebugProbes and streams it to the visualizer backend.
  • A live React view is embedded in an IDE tool window (JCEF), auto-navigating to your run's session over SSE.

Getting Started

  1. Open the Coroutine Visualizer settings and point it at your visualizer backend URL.
  2. Select a run configuration and choose Run with Coroutine Visualizer (the bundled agent attaches automatically — no dependency or code change).
  3. Open the Coroutine Visualizer tool window — it auto-navigates to your run's live session.

Development tool. The embedded view shows coroutine creation-stack source paths and is intended for development/debugging on trusted backends only.

action.description: Run the current configuration with coroutine visualization enabled
